meta.title: A quantity sent as text fails with a raw Ruby message
gaps: The pull operation/path is not defined among the operations or library cases.
The required productUuid and productQualityUuid tokens are unavailable for constructing the pull request body.
The available EDGE-DPRE-008 library case tests a negative numeric quantity, not a text quantity, and cannot be modified to use "5".
The expected raw Ruby message and codes 15, 557 are not expressible with the available assertion vocabulary.
